subject: Runtime error of Shiny-app in Amazon AWS

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Runtime error of Shiny-app in Amazon AWS
parts:
Hi all,

I have created a Shiny-app (kind of data-heavy application), which is running perfectly locally as well as in shinyapps.io.

Based on that deployment I tried to deploy the same in Amazon AWS, however got error when I try to run my App from there.

The error in the Browser says that "ERROR: An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification."

Next I tried to Inspect that error, and see below :

Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error)

Currently, I am using free version of AWS. Any idea how to get that resolved, will be highly appreciated.

Thanks for your time.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Runtime error of Shiny-app in Amazon AWS
parts:
I am unclear what you mean by deploying to a free version of AWS.
But this group is for hosting Shiny applications on shinyapps.io. If you are running your own Shiny server on AWS, you might try https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/sections/204025308-Shiny-Server or if you are running a professional product open a support ticket.
